label: Too small
description: Item did not fit; customer needed a larger size
notes: Repeated 'too small' on worn items is a serial-returner signal (see C-1007 boots)

label: Too large
description: Item did not fit; customer needed a smaller size
notes: Usually genuine; item normally returns in new condition

label: Colour differs
description: Colour received did not match the website listing
notes: Cluster on one SKU points to a misleading product photo, not customer fault

label: Not as described
description: Item materially differs from the listing (spec
column8: Feeds product-content fixes; distinct from QUALITY

label: Quality below expectation
description: Item works but build/material quality disappointed
notes: Often non-restockable once used; candidate for liquidation

label: Faulty / not working
description: Item is defective or unsafe on arrival or first use
notes: SAFETY sub-cases must be escalated to a human, never auto-processed (see R-50021 stove gas leak)

label: Damaged in transit
description: Item arrived physically damaged or with damaged packaging
notes: Routes to carrier-claims process; check packaging condition

label: Changed mind
description: Customer no longer wants the item; no fault
notes: Restockable only if returned new with tags/seal intact

label: Unwanted gift
description: Gift the recipient did not want

label: Arrived too late
notes: Signals a fulfilment/delivery issue upstream of returns

label: Bought multiple to compare
description: Customer ordered several variants/sizes intending to keep one
notes: Legitimate behaviour (see R-50017/R-50031/R-50032) — must NOT be flagged as abuse

label: No fault found
description: Returned as faulty but tests clean on inspection
notes: Repeat 'faulty' electronics with no fault found is an abuse signal (see C-1019)

label: Other / uncoded
description: Catch-all used when the agent cannot quickly map the free-text to a code
notes: The problem code: ~41% of returns land here, erasing analytics. The assistant's job is to read reason_text and replace OTHER with the right code + a confidence score
